name: Cahokia Mounds State Historic Site
description: Just across the Mississippi River from St. Louis, Cahokia was the largest city north of Mexico a thousand years ago, home to perhaps 10,000 to 20,000 people around 1100. Visitors can climb beside Monks Mound, a 30-metre earthen giant covering over 5 hectares, and walk among the surviving mounds of a city that once had about 120.
